newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ECI Telecom sees 30 pct rise in 1996 sales.
newsitem.headline: ECI Telecom sees 30 pct rise in 1996 sales.

text.p: ECI Telecom sees its 1996 worldwide sales rising by 30 percent to $580 million, company president David Rubner said.

Rubner, speaking to reporters in Manila late on Tuesday night, could not say how much profit the company was expecting for all of 1996 but added that in 1995, profits of the company were 17 percent of sales.

Rubner said that the company was planning to set up a manufacturing facility in the Philippines, possibly by 1998. ECI Telecom Philippines is marking its first anniversary of operations in the country this week.

"We are still formulating the strategy on whether we will do it on our own or with a joint venture partner. We see the Philippines as a strategic market for ECI, especially with its existing tele-density and the deregulation of the telecoms industry," Rubner said.
Rubner said the proposed manufacturing facility, estimated to cost $15 million to $20 million, will serve the domestic and possibly the export market.
So far, Rubner said sales of the telecommunications equipment maker in the Philippines had reached $100 million.
